## Change

Describe the update and why it is needed.

## Public sources

Link the documentation or changelog supporting changed product claims. Write N/A for tooling-only changes.

## Review

- [ ] Correct base: feature/fix to `develop`; release from `develop` to `main`.
- [ ] Plans, repository visibility, deployment availability, GA/preview status and AI usage labels reviewed where changed.
- [ ] No secrets, private customer information or internal-only sources added.
- [ ] Validation is green; desktop/mobile, both themes, feature dialogs and presentation screenshots reviewed.
- [ ] Code scanning and dependency alerts reviewed.
- [ ] As-of date changed only if the corresponding factual review was completed.

## Release

For `develop` to `main`: summarize the approved changes and the live-site checks to perform after publishing.
